threads.label: The treasure map
threads.text: It led you to Brandonsford at sunset, but the places it marks are ones you don't recognize. The treasure itself is still unfound.

threads.label: The Clurichen
threads.text: Reginald the frog warned you to avoid this trickster, which comes up from the riverbanks every night. What it does in town is still unknown.

threads.label: Eric the Reeve's bounty
threads.text: He offers a thousand gold for the black dragon near Brandonsford, brought into town dead. He didn't accept Sir Phidipaldi's duel challenge. Farmer Gill's three sons are already hunting it.

threads.label: Lady Hilda
threads.text: She offered to join your dragon hunt for pay, and Sir Phidipaldi said you'd be back. If you return to the Clumsy Fox and pay her, she'll join.

threads.label: Brandonsford's missing supplies
threads.text: Bentley and Farmer Gill say shipments have stopped reaching town. What's stopping them is still unknown.

threads.label: Drop Dead Ned
threads.text: Dr. Uriah met this thief and his killer wasp. For a hundred gold a week, he'll do anything that lets him kill, refunding five gold per kill if the bodies are his.

threads.label: Warwick the smith
threads.text: He keeps adding lucky charms and growing more paranoid, and nobody knows why yet.

threads.label: Quinn's vanishing ale
threads.text: Quinn, owner of the Golden Egg, offered Sir Phidipaldi a hundred gold to catch whoever drains the bar each night. Who or what does it is still unknown.

threads.label: Dunk and Farmer Gill
threads.text: Dunk heard Gill's legend of Sir Brandon and kept him drinking on his porch all evening.

closing: Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn, in the empty Golden Egg, are about to stage a fake delivery of water-filled bottles as ale. Wayman Tisdale and Dr. Uriah are across the street at the Clumsy Fox. Dunk is at Farmer Gill's farm, where he can sleep in the barn.
